notes.title: Behold the PC Gaming Show: with nuns in space and the voice of Sister Argenta!
notes.content:
[p]As devoted indie devs, we've always dreamed (and prayed) to be in the [b]PC Gaming Show[/b], because we've watched it for years. This year we're in it with a little teaser, thanks to all of you! (We're near the end of the show). We also did a fun collaboration with Sister Argenta (from Rogue Trader), hope you like it :D[/p][p][/p][p]To anyone who has wishlisted the game so far, you helped make this happen, so may your souls be forever saved.   Watch the show on Sunday, June 8 at 12 noon PDT, 3pm EDT and 8pm BST here :[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YXC7hf6PBTE"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]
Join us on Discord for celebration, prayers and future playtests: [url="https://discord.gg/K4UckVA6Gc"]https://discord.gg/K4UckVA6Gc[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Blessed be, Martyrs! The scriptures provide new visions, closed playtest
notes.content:
[p]We've been working on some stuff for a new trailer, and also some gameplay improvements based on the first playtesters feedback, so these are some sneak peaks. There's a lot to do still to make the game more enjoyable, but we pray you can see the improvements in the next playtest. [/p][p][/p][h1]Join us on Discord for the next closed playtest[/h1][p]
Next batch of playtesting Martyrs will start in a couple of weeks: [url="https://discord.gg/K4UckVA6Gc"]https://discord.gg/K4UckVA6Gc[/url] [/p][p][/p][h1]Behold new visions of the future![/h1][p]
[b]New nun docking at the space monastery:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495660/c2c5f07de9bab77d1940f3deae4753c1adce360a.jpg"][/img][b]Making it clearer when you receive a stigmata blessing:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495660/528fd8e5e2b25b0ec6bc188b5f7922dcdfb83311.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Or a stigmata curse:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495660/24287d12590e6252f336841caa17ba31e8c95fcb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Probably the in-game view of it:[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495660/02c36142d407057868c0c5afa76997c9a4d15ccb.jpg"][/img]
[b]New interactable to boost your faith:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495660/635d507c91c8b9818f1dd631f2cc6195ae58cbda.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Something lurks in the shadows:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495660/d71b0815ef9a5e49f79a298116d14c4986bc48be.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]WTF:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495660/3641b4ec0d0172f4f779ce6a8f32504d16033dae.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Void Martyrs is 'Grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit' so sign me up
notes.content: Do you like the Sisters of Battle from Warhammer 40,000? How about the birdseye sci-fi survival horror of Signalis? The roguelite progression of Void Bastards? The whole vibe of Event Horizon? If at least three of those things seem like your cup of recaf, then sit down and let me tell you about Void Martyrs... Read more.
